# MDL510 · `extra-file-section-dropped`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

The defaults file is rejected, so the extra file's table sections and variable groups are ignored.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | F15, F1 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl510-defaults-rejected-drops-extra-masking`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl510-defaults-rejected-drops-extra-masking.txtar), [`mdl510-defaults-rejected-extra-options-still-apply`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl510-defaults-rejected-extra-options-still-apply.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper and myloader merge the extra file (`--defaults-extra-file`) into the defaults file, then read table sections, server variable groups and per-product option groups from the merged file only. When GLib rejects the defaults file there is nothing to merge into: these sections of the extra file are silently ignored, masking included, while its [mydumper] or [myloader] options still apply. Fix the defaults file. Only load sets (design §9.3) let mydumper-lint see both files.

## Example

With mydumper v1.0.5-1:

The defaults file, `defaults.cnf` (`--defaults-file`):

```ini
[client]
host=db
[mydumper]
key[bar baz]=1
```

❌ Before, the extra file (`--defaults-extra-file`):

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=3
[`app`.`users`]
`email`=random_string
[mydumper_session_variables]
sql_mode=
[mydumper_mysql]
no-data=1
[`app`.`orders`]
where=id>0
[`app`.`users`]
`name`=random_string
```

```text
3:2-3:15 error MDL510[extra-file-section-dropped] this table section is ignored: it is read from the defaults file merged with this one, and GLib rejects defaults.cnf (line 4)
  = Its masked columns are dumped in plaintext, and its other settings do not apply.
5:2-5:28 error MDL510[extra-file-section-dropped] this variable group is ignored: it is read from the defaults file merged with this one, and GLib rejects defaults.cnf (line 4)
  = These server variables are not set.
7:2-7:16 error MDL510[extra-file-section-dropped] this per-product option group is ignored: it is read from the defaults file merged with this one, and GLib rejects defaults.cnf (line 4)
  = These options do not apply.
9:2-9:16 error MDL510[extra-file-section-dropped] this table section is ignored: it is read from the defaults file merged with this one, and GLib rejects defaults.cnf (line 4)
  = None of its settings apply.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL510: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL510` on the line above it.
